CONSTRUCTION SKILLS
14.1 INTRODUCTION
In order to make any garment, it is necessary to make a drafting before cutting. If one
knows how to make a drafting then the cloth can be properly cut and a well fitting garment
according to measurements can be made. Many accessories are used in various garments
like-velcro, lace, elastic, ribbon, etc. Hence, we should also know how and where these
accessories are used.
13.2
OBJECTIVES
After reading this lesson, you will be able to :
•
explain and demonstrate the use of velcro and elastic.
I
14.3 USE OF VELCRO
-
This is a type of adhesive tape. Both the tapes are rough on one side and have an adhesive
quality. It is plain on thereverse side. It is used in curtains, on bags and cushions and even
on sandal straps now-a-days. It is used to close openings. It is quite convenient in use.
For example, if we want to put up two curtains, we can sew them together to make it look
as one: But then it willnot be possible to open it from the center. But if we use a velcro
.tape', then the two curtains can be opened and closed as desired. Hence it becomes
convenient and easy to do many things by using velcro.

14.4 USE OF ELASTIC
Elastics are generally used in children's garments. Since children can not manage to tie
tapes illtheir.clothes, it is convenient to use elastics. Elastics are of various types - narrow,
round, flat (Y4" to 1W') and sometimes an even broader elastic is used in skirts. Elastics
are used in children's pyjama tops and bottoms; in sleeve bottoms, injhablas and in skirts
and knickers, etc. The garments can be fitted as desired with the use of elastic. Elastics
also form an important aspect of designing.
